quests.question: Convert to reported speech: Noor said, "I have finished my homework."
options: Noor said that she has finished her homework.
Noor said that she had finished her homework.
Noor said that she had finished my homework.
quests.correctAnswer: Noor said that she had finished her homework.
quests.sentence: Noor said, "I have finished my homework."
quests.hint: Present perfect 'have finished' moves two steps back — what tense is that?
quests.explanation: 'Have finished' (present perfect) backshifts to 'had finished' (past perfect); 'I' and 'my' become 'she' and 'her'.
